description: Find Japanese companies and their 13-digit corporate numbers (法人番号) in gBizINFO, the Japanese government corporate registry run by METI. Search by company name, prefecture, corporate form, capital, employee count, revenue, or by whether the company has government procurement awards, subsidies, patents or filed financials. Returns each match with its corporate number, Japanese legal name, romanised name, registered address, capital and headcount.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own gBizINFO API token, if you would rather use your own quota than the shared one. Register free at https://info.gbiz.go.jp/hojin/various_registration/form — pick 個人利用者 (individual) unless you have a Japanese 法人番号.

city.description: Municipality code from the same JIS scheme.

corporate_type.description: Corporate form code: 301 株式会社 (joint-stock), 302 有限会社, 303 合名会社, 304 合資会社, 305 合同会社, 201 local government, 101 national body.

founded_year.description: Year of establishment, or several comma-separated.

has.description: Restrict to companies that have records of a given kind: procurement, commendation, certification, subsidy, patent, finance.

name.description: Company name, partial match. PASS THE JAPANESE NAME WHERE YOU CAN ("トヨタ自動車"): a Latin-script query is matched against the romanised name field, which is sparse and dominated by municipal bodies — "Toyota" returns Toyota City property wards, not トヨタ自動車株式会社. The response flags this when it applies.

prefecture.description: Prefecture code, 2 digits from the JIS local-government code (13 = Tokyo, 23 = Aichi, 27 = Osaka).

name: gbiz_company_search
title: Gbiz Company Search
